title: Congruence Classes of Supporting the Erdös-Straus Conjecture I: Tame Solutions
summary: In 1948, Erdös and Straus formulated a conjecture : for any positive integer $n>2$, there exist positive integers $n_1,n_2$ and $n_3$ such that \begin{equation}\frac{4}{n}=\frac{1}{n_1}+\frac{1}{n_2}+\frac{1}{n_3},\nonumber\end{equation} which is still open. It is known that one only needs to prove the conjecture for any prime number $n$ such that $n\equiv 1\;(\mbox{mod}\;24)$. If $n=24m+1$ and $n_1\leq n_2,n_3$, then $n_1=6m+k$ with $1\leq k\leq 12m$.
